title: Tanvi Sharma Advances at French Open, Sets Up Potential Clash with World No. 1
indian_angle: Indian shuttler Tanvi Sharma defeated compatriot Isharani Baruah to progress in the French Open, with a challenging match against World No. 1 An Se-young potentially next.
summary: Tanvi Sharma secured a victory over Isharani Baruah in the French Open, moving closer to a highly anticipated Round of 16 encounter with top seed An Se-young.

title: Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand Begin French Open Campaign
indian_angle: Indian women's doubles pair Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand are set to play their Round of 32 match at the French Open 2026.
summary: Fans can find live streaming information for the French Open 2026 women's doubles Round of 32 match featuring India's Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand.

title: BAI Announces Formation of New Athletes Committee
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India has officially formed its Athletes Committee, aiming to provide players with a stronger voice in decision-making processes.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has announced the formation of its new Athletes Committee, a significant step towards enhancing player involvement and representation within the sport's administration.

title: National Coaching Camp Underway for BWF World Junior Championships
indian_angle: India's top junior shuttlers are currently participating in a national coaching camp in Guwahati, preparing for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships 2026.
summary: A national coaching camp for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026 is being held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, bringing together India's most promising young badminton talents for intensive training.

title: BAI Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course Held in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India conducted a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course across two national centers, aiming to enhance the quality of coaching in India.
summary: The BAI successfully organized a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14-23, 2026, to certify and upskill badminton coaches across the country.

title: BAI Implements 3x15 Scoring System for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India has adopted the 3x15 scoring system for U-13, U-15, and U-17 domestic ranking tournaments and national championships, impacting junior player development.
summary: A new 3x15 scoring system has been implemented by the BAI for junior domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups, effective from June 30, 2026.
